Strategy: Refine Best Fit with a room-for-another bonus: keep the tightness score and add a bonus when the leftover exceeds one item, plus a bonus for an exact fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when a looser bin leaves more than one item while the tightest bin leaves less, since the bonus can outweigh the gap. Keeping one-item room may pair items, but the bonus can pass over tight fits that waste less space.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(10000 if r == item else 0) - (r - item) + (40 if r - item > item else 0) for r in bins]
```
